key_insight: A slice-wise synthetic reasoning dataset can teach a 2D-pretrained multimodal model to understand 3D medical volumes more accurately and interpretably.
clinical_relevance: This approach may improve volumetric image reading support in medical AI while making the model’s spatial reasoning easier to inspect.
method: Built a large structured dataset from 3D scans using slice-by-slice synthesis.
Mimicked radiologist workflow by turning global priors into per-slice observations and a Chain-of-Thought.
Instruction-tuned a standard 2D-pretrained MLLM on the synthesized data for volumetric comprehension.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports significant gains across multiple 3D medical benchmarks, with the tuned model approaching the performance of resource-intensive native 3D architectures.
watch_item: Results depend on the quality of synthesized reasoning data, so errors or bias in the generation pipeline could affect real-world reliability.
paper_title: Towards Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
